registration.title: A18 as the stored challenger beside the live model, with a switch
registration.what: Every run works out two match models: the club-rank model ('base') and the same with A18's boosted trees on top ('a18'). A switch in the Admin area names the live one, which the site and the paper bets use; the other's prediction is stored before each kickoff.
registration.why: The owner wants models side by side, switchable with a button, each tracked on the same live matches from predictions made before kickoff, rather than re-created afterwards.
registration.how: A18's features, weekly Poisson model and trees ported into the production code and checked against the experiment on every past fixture; the trees retrained each half-season on the base model's errors. Migration 20261014_challenger_model.sql: the switch, its log and the challenger's predictions.
registration.hypothesis: On live matches, 'a18' has lower result log loss than 'base'.

expected.improves: Result log loss and the goal markets.

metrics.source: experiments/a18_on_release/results.json: A18 refitted on the released club rank, final period at 95% (a seen period)

expected.confidence: The final period had been looked at before; P17 and P18 are the tests on unseen matches.

registration.success_criteria: Protocol P18: the confidence sequence of a18 minus base log loss on live matches, both stored before kickoff. Proven better: the owner may switch to a18. Proven worse: the owner is told.

events.note: Promoted to main on 2026-10-14 with the base model live; a18 is worked out beside it from the first scheduled run after it, and the switch is the owner's.
